title: Faithful Model Evaluation for Model-Based Metrics

bias_targets.methodology: Using a model-based toxicity classifier (RoBERTa-ToxiGen) to evaluate the toxicity of open-ended text generated by language models (GPT2, GPT-Neo) using the RealToxicityPrompts dataset.
Evaluating the toxicity of text generated by language models in response to gender-specific prompts from the BOLD benchmark dataset using a model-based toxicity classifier.
Evaluating the toxicity of text generated by language models in response to race-specific prompts from the BOLD benchmark dataset using a model-based toxicity classifier.
Evaluating the toxicity of text generated by language models in response to religion-specific prompts from the BOLD benchmark dataset using a model-based toxicity classifier.
Evaluating the toxicity of text generated by language models in response to political ideology-specific prompts from the BOLD benchmark dataset using a model-based toxicity classifier.
Evaluating the toxicity of text generated by language models in response to profession-specific prompts from the BOLD benchmark dataset using a model-based toxicity classifier.
